changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Fri 13, 6:20 AM)
items: The east wind eased a little and the mix improved, but supply still dips this weekend. Fishing right now is 4 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 1 VERY POOR (was 6 GOOD / 0 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 5 VERY POOR). Only Nangalao stays VERY POOR (20 kt, gusts 27). Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan moved up to POOR (17–20 kt). Galoc and Maglalambay slipped from GOOD to MARGINAL, Coron and Binudac moved up from POOR to MARGINAL, and Panlaitan (GOOD) and Culion (POOR) held their classes.

Regional wind: Fri 13 12 kt, gusts 18; Sat 14 13 kt, gusts 19 (roughest); Sun 15 10 kt with light rain (1.0 mm); Mon 16 12 kt; Tue 17 10 kt; Wed 18 4.1 kt (best day); Thu 19 7.8 kt. Supply: slightly soft Sat 14, SOFT Sun 15, then recovering from Mon. Shortage detector ELEVATED, surge OFF. PAGASA feed was unreachable again (SSL error); the CLEAR on the dashboard is only a default, not a confirmed check.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight about 6 PM through Sat 5 AM at Tara, Decabobo and Turda (wind 3.5–6 kt, current 0.0–0.8 kt); Coron, Culion and Galoc about 6–11 PM (wind 2–3 kt)
details: Sat 14 (13 kt, gusts 19) is the roughest day , with arrivals soft on Sun. Relief arrives Sun 15 (10 kt, light rain); Mon 16 rebuilds to 12 kt, then Wed 18 is the best day (4.1 kt).

Tara, Decabobo and Turda: wind 4–6 kt from now to 5 AM, then 8–10 kt about 6–9 AM Sat; current 0.7–0.8 kt about 6–10 PM (Tara, Turda), otherwise 0.0–0.5 kt, 0.2 kt about 2–5 AM. Coron, Culion and Galoc: wind 1.6–3 kt about 6–11 PM (Galoc current 0.3–0.4; Coron 0.2–0.4; Culion about 0.6–0.7). Panlaitan and Maglalambay: wind 4–7 kt until about 4 AM, current 0.0–0.5 kt.
